ownerDecisions.decision: Smarter Justice centrally manages private accounts, firms, seats, billing, verification, support, and shared profile data; focused legal micro-portals own public specialty profiles. Attorneys may self-create or receive owner-assisted private records without a prebuilt listing.

Smarter Justice is the active self-contained operating and governance system for its legal portfolio. Roger is the final owner and decision authority. Neutral Boardroom is dormant, optional, non-blocking, and not a source of truth, runtime dependency, management dependency, or launch dependency.

Pilot order is Divorce Law Aid, Estate Law Aid, then Personal Injury Law Aid. Personal Injury includes vehicle accidents. Workers’ Compensation remains separate. Car Accident Law Aid remains an independent dormant compatibility asset and is not separately launched.
Portal-first claim and central Smarter Justice execution controls the initial professional enrollment architecture.
The historical v1.7.43 complimentary profile pilot is superseded; free basic profile control is now a normal platform rule and paid growth remains separately gated.
The active initial launch consists of Divorce Law Aid, Estate Law Aid, Personal Injury Law Aid, and Domestic Violence Aid. Historical three-portal records remain historical.
